data_fields.name: journal_group_id
data_fields.donor_constant: byte, taken from transition flags bits 16-23

data_fields.name: journal_line_time
data_fields.donor_constant: GameTime stamp written on insert and on change

data_fields.name: journal_line_chapter
data_fields.donor_constant: CHAPTER global read on every write

data_fields.name: dialog_state_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: rank = DLG trigger index; first passing state wins

best_idea: A quest log keyed by line text, where solving one line with a group key replaces the whole group in one step, so a quest's stages collapse to one solved line with no cleanup script.
decision_why: Keep the group-supersede rule and first-passing-state dialogue pick; fix the duplicate-line defect (the donor leaves an old line when groups differ) and the biased random pick; derive quest lines from the one ledger instead of keeping a second list.
acceptance: A server test asserts that solving group G removes every line of G and any earlier line with the same text, that re-solving a solved line changes nothing, and that a random greeting over 10,000 draws picks each passing line within 2% of an equal share.
